premises.text: Shorter student attention spans make long textbook study compete poorly with social apps, so learning must become personalized and addictive

premises.text: OCR plus ML can turn a textbook photo into categorized flashcards in seconds

premises.text: A messaging-app tutor (Milo) generates Q&A, essay help, and other learning aids from short text prompts where students already spend time

premises.text: Task-specific semantic language models trained on product data run much faster than general prompt-engineered benchmarks
premises.evidence_span: this is done by training task-specific behavior in the model itself
